About InCharge Energy InCharge Energy provides electric vehicle charging infrastructure and related solutions designed to support the transition to electrified transportation. We work with commercial fleets and organizations to develop scalable charging solutions that address the operational, infrastructure, and technology requirements of fleet electrification.
We are seeking an experienced Chief Product Officer (CPO)
to lead product strategy, product development, and innovation across our growing portfolio of EV charging and energy infrastructure solutions.
The Role As Chief Product Officer, you will be responsible for defining and executing the company's product vision and strategy. You will work closely with executive leadership, engineering, technology, operations, sales, marketing, and customer-facing teams to develop products and solutions that address evolving customer needs and market opportunities.
The ideal candidate combines strategic product leadership with a strong understanding of technology, infrastructure, customer experience, and commercial execution.
Key Responsibilities Define and lead the company's long-term product vision, strategy, and roadmap.
Build and manage a scalable product organization aligned with company growth objectives.
Oversee the development and lifecycle management of EV charging, energy infrastructure, software, and related technology solutions.
Translate customer requirements, market developments, and emerging technologies into actionable product opportunities.
Partner with engineering and technology teams to prioritize product development and deliver reliable, scalable solutions.
Collaborate with sales, marketing, operations, and business development teams on product positioning and go-to-market strategy.
Establish product priorities, performance metrics, and processes for measuring product success.
Evaluate competitive developments and identify opportunities for product differentiation.
Develop business cases for new products, capabilities, partnerships, and strategic initiatives.
Represent the product organization in executive-level strategic planning and decision-making.
Recruit, develop, and lead high-performing product management teams.
Maintain a strong understanding of developments across EV charging, fleet electrification, energy management, and associated infrastructure technologies.

Qualifications 10+ years of experience in product management, product strategy, technology, or related leadership roles.
Significant experience leading product organizations at the VP, SVP, CPO, or comparable executive level.
Demonstrated success developing and scaling technology-enabled products or infrastructure solutions.
Experience within EV charging, transportation electrification, energy technology, clean technology, SaaS, IoT, or related industries is strongly preferred.
Strong understanding of product lifecycle management, technology development, and commercialization.
Proven ability to translate complex customer and market requirements into clear product strategies.
Experience working effectively across engineering, operations, sales, marketing, and executive leadership teams.
Strong analytical, strategic planning, communication, and organizational skills.
Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, computer science, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
